tools.name: registry_totals
tools.description: A headline number for a post, slide or dashboard: how many MCP servers the Official MCP Registry lists, split by status (active, deprecated), remote transport (streamable-http, sse) and package type (npm, pypi, ...). Good for 'How many MCP servers are there, and how many run remotely?'. Example: reg

tools.name: new_servers_count_since
tools.description: Growth since any date: how many MCP servers were first published on or after it, split by namespace type. Good for 'How many new MCP servers since October?'. Example: new_servers_count_since(date="2026-10-01") -> {since, count, by_namespace_type}. Date format YYYY-MM-DD. The date is optional: with n

tools.name: snapshot_info
tools.description: What to cite: the snapshot date and source behind the other tools, and which fields are kept or dropped. Good for 'Which day do these numbers describe and where do they come from?'. Example: snapshot_info() -> {snapshot_at, source, fields_kept, fields_dropped}. No arguments.
